description: Zones disposant d'un accès wifi is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d’Agglomération du Centre Littoral de Guyane. Places covered by a public WIFI network on the City of Cayenne. Coverage: Communauté d’Agglomération du Centre Littoral de Guyane. The portal shows the English title as "Areas with wifi access" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d’Agglomération du Centre Littoral de Guyane. Its keywords include internet, connectivite, wifi, communes-membres-de-la-cacl. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, XLS. The listing shows 2021-10-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
